description: This file defines the 'AdminFilter' class which extends Spring's HandlerInterceptorAdapter to implement a pre-processing request filter for admin-related functionality. It manages user sessions, permissions, menu loading, and language settings for admin pages in a web application.

classes.name: AdminFilter
classes.description: A web filter component that intercepts admin requests for user validation, menu setup, and language preferences for the admin interface.

methods.name: preHandle
methods.description: Main method executed before request handling to setup session attributes, user validation, menu initialization, and language selection.

methods.name: getMenu
methods.description: Helper method to parse a nested menu structure from JSON data into Menu objects.
